siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of L'Oustau de Baumanière
siblings.summary: The Alpilles are a tech-conference desert. Within 30 km of L'Oustau de Baumanière the only dedicated IT events are CIP-PACA's monthly Avignon afterworks and Avignon Université's LIA research seminars — everything bigger is in Marseille.
